verdict.rationale: Semgrep ships a well-documented official CLI. It installs via pipx or uv, offers `semgrep scan` for local scans without an account and `semgrep ci` for platform scans, and supports machine-readable SARIF export, `--autofix` and `--dry-run`, with no login required. Independent hands-on use confirms the CLI fits automated LLM pipelines: a team at Microsoft fed its SARIF output to LLMs to prioritise triage. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of agent-oriented CLI behaviour (e.g., guidance for non-interactive or agent invocation, or structured JSON output aimed at AI tooling) beyond SARIF export.
